# Mood Meter

> Mood Meter is a free, privacy-first mood tracker app for iOS and Android. No ads, no subscriptions, no locked premium features.

## Key facts
- Price: free (no ads, no in-app subscriptions)
- Platforms: iOS (App Store), Android (Google Play)
- Features: quick mood capture, deep mood analytics, full control over your data
- Privacy: does not track identity or sell data to advertisers

## Links
- [Home](https://moodmeter.cend.in/): overview, features, FAQ
- [Privacy Policy](https://moodmeter.cend.in/privacy_policy.html): how data is handled
